visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The frame is divided into three horizontal panels. The top panel shows a high-detail close-up of a white and grey New Balance sneaker stepping repeatedly onto a white surface. The middle panel features a young man with short black hair in a grey graphic t-shirt, speaking to the camera with a calm smile in a brightly lit indoor hallway. The bottom panel displays a group of four young men wearing blue and yellow professional esports jerseys, sitting at gaming stations with large monitors and headsets in a dimly lit studio environment. (2) The middle panel transitions through several rapid cuts showing different young men in the same blue and yellow jerseys. Each character exhibits surprised facial expressions, such as wide eyes or open mouths, while looking directly at the camera. The backgrounds for these individuals vary between a spacious indoor mall area with warm lighting and a more neutral indoor setting. The top panel continues the repetitive stepping motion of the shoe, while the bottom panel remains a static view of the players at their desks.
